newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures slip in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower across the board on Tuesday, pressured by profit-taking after gaining during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 0.7 yen per kilo lower than the day's close. Benchmark April was 0.7 yen lower at 142.6 yen. Volume was 11,286 lots.

During the day, prices edged higher, backed by the yen's further weakness against the dollar. An emerging view that Japan's rubber stocks will not rise significantly from current levels provided further support for the market.
